title: Nark Georgian Vs. Katya Chilly - "Month"/"OV Sirun Sirun" - Fighting - Voice of the Country Season 7
description: Nark and Katya perform "Month" (Ukrainian Folk Song) and "OV Sirun Sirun" (Armenian Folk Song) in the 9th air of season 7 of the country's voice. Watch the online voice of the country 7 Season 9 Issue from 19.03.2017 - vocal fights, Tina Karol team. VK: https://vk.com/goloskrainy FB: https://www.facebook.com/goloskrainy Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/goloskrainy_official
